generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can remain internally consistent while a result-only publication drops cumulative audit history or a retention-backed report labels unavailable history as complete.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Trust only the newly generated result package and happy-path report payload instead of comparing cumulative ledgers with their parent and requested reporting windows with the effective retention boundary.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Preserve cumulative audit ledgers across result-only publication and derive report availability from the same effective retention boundary used by storage cleanup and bounded queries.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject a result child that loses any parent ledger identifier and reject coverage metadata whose state or available interval contradicts the retention-backed query window.

transfer_cases.scenario: A generated verification child contains only the latest remediation entry while its material parent contains an older active escape.
A reporting endpoint requests a period starting before retained aggregates and must expose partial availability while clamping the data query to the retained boundary.

skill_changes.change: Terminal result-child publication now requires cumulative ledger comparison with the material parent, and retention-backed reporting activates a coverage consistency gate.
Final validation now rederives reporting-availability risk and blocks cumulative result-child lineage loss or coverage states inconsistent with retention.
